hooks.command: if command -v wm-squeeze >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec wm-squeeze --pre-tool --py ./hooks/pre_tool_guard.py; elif [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/wm-squeeze" ]; then exec "$HOME/.local/bin/wm-squeeze" --pre-tool --py ./hooks/pre_tool_guard.py; else exec python3 -S -B ./hooks/pre_tool_guard.py; fi

if command -v wm-squeeze >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec wm-squeeze --post-tool; elif [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/wm-squeeze" ]; then exec "$HOME/.local/bin/wm-squeeze" --post-tool; else exec python3 -S -B ./hooks/post_tool_sim.py; fi

PostInvocation.command: if command -v wm-squeeze >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec wm-squeeze --hud; elif [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/wm-squeeze" ]; then exec "$HOME/.local/bin/wm-squeeze" --hud; else exec python3 -S -B ./hooks/longevity_hud.py; fi
